note: BSI IT-Grundschutz-Kompendium, Edition 2023, from the agency's own DocBook XML. Published by a federal agency and edited to a house standard, which is what makes it usable here. No region selector: the whole document is BSI's text. This replaced a private registry extract of the same Kompendium, which held a quarter of the text and a sixth of the German quotation marks; the XML is the publisher's structured original, so the spacing and the quotation marks are exactly as BSI set them.
